description: This file defines testing actions and interfaces for Kubernetes client-go, including functions to create various action objects (get, list, create, update, delete, patch, watch, proxy) and their implementations, classes representing different actions, and utility functions for extracting list options.

classes.name: ActionImpl
classes.description: Base implementation of the Action interface, providing common fields and methods for actions.

classes.name: GenericActionImpl
classes.description: Generic implementation of an Action with a value payload.

classes.name: GetActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a get action, including resource, name, and options.

classes.name: ListActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a list action, including restrictions and options.

classes.name: CreateActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a create action, including object and options.

classes.name: UpdateActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an update action, including object and options.

classes.name: PatchActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a patch action, including patch data and options.

classes.name: DeleteActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a delete action, including delete options.

classes.name: DeleteCollectionActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a delete collection action, including restrictions.

classes.name: WatchActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a watch action, including restrictions.

classes.name: ProxyGetActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a proxy get action, including scheme, port, path, and params.

methods.name: ExtractFromListOptions
methods.description: Utility function to extract label and field selectors and resource version from list options.
